title: Repository Configuration Schema
description: Unified schema for repository configuration and module contracts

paths.description: Repository path configuration (optional, has sensible defaults)

registries.description: Container registry configurations for cleanup policies

containers.description: Container tool configurations with version pinning

type.description: Repository type: mono (monorepo), poly (polyrepo), adjacent (supporting repo)

schemes.description: Valid versioning schemes that modules can declare. Implicit is always available as the default.

trunk_branch.description: Main branch name for trunk-based development

max_branch_age_days.description: Maximum age in days for feature branches

parallelism.description: Parallelism limits for build and test commands

remote.description: Remote VCS repository configuration (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, etc.)

remote_config.description: Remote VCS repository configuration. Only owner is required - URLs are derived from type + owner if not specified.

owner.description: Organization or username on the VCS provider (required)

repo.description: Repository name - auto-detected from git if not set

url.description: Repository URL - derived from type/owner if not set

pages_url.description: Documentation site URL - derived from type/owner if not set

registry_url.description: Container registry URL - derived from type/owner if not set

parallelism_config.description: Parallelism limits for build and test operations. CI uses lower limits to avoid resource contention on shared runners.

ci.description: Maximum parallel workers in CI environment (GitHub Actions)

devbox.description: Maximum parallel workers in local development environment

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Automatically delete branch after PR merge

merge_strategy.description: Default merge strategy for pull requests

versioning_config.description: Repository-wide versioning constraints and behavior control

constraint.description: Global constraint on version bumping. unrestricted: Allow major, minor, and patch bumps based on conventional commits. patch-only: For semver modules, only allow patch bumps (0.0.x → 0.0.x+1) - stops major/minor bumps during early development. calver-only: Force all modules to use calendar versioning.

paths_config.description: Repository path configuration for specs, tests, and output directories

ai_prompts_paths.description: AI prompt template paths with three-tier priority system

system.description: System default prompts (version controlled, shipped with repo)

team.description: Team override prompts (version controlled, team customizations)

out_paths.description: Output directory structure for build artifacts, test results, and logs

tools.description: Tools output directory (CI tools like commands binary)

conventions_config.description: Filename conventions used across the repository

description.description: Module description (defaults to name if not specified)

template.description: Name of a module template to use as base configuration. Templates are defined in defaults/module-templates.yml.

auto_discover.description: Enable automatic discovery of conventional components (gherkin, structurizr, test-impl, markdown)

parameters.description: Template parameter values for placeholder substitution (e.g., go_root)

depends_on.description: List of module monikers this module depends on (defaults to []). Use the special value 'root' to mark a module as root-level baseline tooling; when 'root' is specified it must be the only entry.

depends_on_ci.description: Module dependencies that require CI artifact downloads. These are merged into depends_on AND tracked separately for CI dispatch layering. Use when this module's CI workflow needs to download build artifacts from the dependency's CI.

metadata.description: Generic key-value store for module-specific data (e.g., executable names, custom properties)

evidence_books.description: Book names for evidence documentation, built via 'update evidence' command. Unlike regular books, these are built independently of the build command.

release_bundle.description: Release bundle configuration for modules that create aggregated releases

components.description: Component types for this module (required - defines what the module contains)

module_components.description: Component types for a module. Maps component type name to its root path or configuration. The first component listed becomes the default for build operations.

oneOf.description: Root path for this component type (relative to repo root)
Use the default_root from component-types.yml (with {moniker} substitution)
Full component configuration with root and optional pattern overrides

component_entry.description: Full component configuration for a module

type.description: Component type (e.g., 'go', 'book'). If omitted, the map key (component name) is used as the type. This allows multiple components of the same type with different names.

root.description: Root path for this component (relative to repo root)

patterns.description: Override default file patterns from component-types

amp.description: Resource amplifier for this component's operations

amp_config.description: Per-operation resource amplifiers (fractional multipliers). Values < 1.0 reduce resources, > 1.0 increase resources.

post_build_config.description: Post-build actions to execute after successful component build

copy_to.description: Target path to copy build output (relative to workspace root)

release_bundle.description: Configuration for release bundle modules that aggregate multiple module releases into a single GitHub release

title_format.description: Release title template with placeholders. Use {label} for version, {label_version} for explicit version. Example: '{clie} ({clie_version}) + {eac} ({eac_version})'

headline.description: Map of label -> moniker for headline modules shown in title

release_bundle_category.description: A category of modules in release notes

post_build.description: Post-build actions to execute after successful build

module_artifact.description: An artifact to be produced by a module build

type.description: Artifact type: executable, file, directory, image

build_options.description: Build behavior options (reserved for future use)

root.description: Root directory for the module (relative to repo root, use '/' for repo root)

exclude.description: File patterns to exclude from ownership

ignore.description: File patterns that are owned but do not trigger change detection (e.g., release workflows, changelogs, README.md). These files belong to the module but changes to them won't trigger CI rebuilds.

changelog.description: Changelog file path relative to module root (defaults to 'CHANGELOG.md')

repo_files.description: Repository-level file ownership (files outside module root)

test_impl.description: Path to test implementation directory (e.g., 'go/eac/specs/impl/repository' for godog step definitions)

design.description: Path to design workspace directory (e.g., 'specs/<moniker>/.design' for Structurizr DSL files)

other.description: Other repository files owned by this module

explicit_ownership.description: When true, the module only owns files matching explicit patterns (source, config, assets, tests). Disables the default 'all files under root' ownership fallback. Use for catch-all modules that should only own specific files.

module_versioning.description: Module versioning configuration. Modules are either supporting (Implicit) or releasable (SemVer/CalVer).

scheme.description: Versioning scheme. Implicit: supporting module with no explicit version, released only as part of releasable modules. SemVer/CalVer: releasable module with explicit version and CI/release pipelines.

changelog.description: Path to changelog file (defaults to release/<moniker>/CHANGELOG.md)

registries_config.description: Container registry configurations keyed by registry hostname

org.description: Organization name in the registry (optional, derived from repository.remote.registry_url if not set)

registry_cleanup_policy.description: Cleanup policy for container images. Uses two protection mechanisms: (1) image tag patterns checked locally, (2) GitHub Release API for release correlation.

enabled.description: Whether cleanup is enabled for this registry

policy.description: Cleanup policy type. keep-latest-n: keep the newest N versions that match prune patterns

keep.description: Number of versions to keep (for keep-latest-n policy)

image_tags.description: Rules based on container image tags (OCI tags visible on the image)

github_releases.description: Rules based on GitHub Release API correlation

min_age_days.description: Minimum age in days before a version can be pruned. Versions created more recently than this are protected.

image_tag_rules.description: Protection rules based on container image tags (OCI/Docker tags like 'v1.0.0', 'sha-abc123', 'latest')

preserve.description: Image tag patterns to preserve (glob). Images with any tag matching these are never deleted. Examples: 'v*' matches 'v1.0.0', 'latest' matches exactly.

prune.description: Image tag patterns eligible for pruning (glob). Only images with tags matching these are candidates. Examples: 'sha-*' matches CI builds, 'pr-*' matches PR builds.

github_release_rules.description: Configuration for GitHub Release API correlation. Images matching GitHub Releases are ALWAYS protected (non-configurable safety feature).

tag_format.description: Expected format of release tags on images. Use {module} and {version} placeholders. Example: '{module}/{version}' matches 'eac-ext/1.0.0'

containers_config.description: Container configurations keyed by container name

base_images.description: Pinned versions for Dockerfile base images

base_images_config.description: Base image version pins (ARG values for Dockerfiles)

dockerfile.description: Path to Dockerfile relative to repo root

image.description: GHCR image reference for container mode

local_binding.description: If true, prefer build mode in local development

description.description: Human-readable description of this container tool

modules.name: Core Domain Libraries
modules.description: Core library containing contracts and repository operations
